_purpose: Drives the October daily-posting push for Breast Cancer Awareness Month. The Generator and Scheduler read this when the active month is October. Goal: maximum awareness AND maximum sales in the brand's biggest visibility window.

weekly_rhythm._note: Daily, but each weekday keeps a job so it never feels like 30 identical posts. Products stay weighted to the weekend; awareness and story carry the week.

MON.goal: Open the week with a real, useful breast cancer fact. Builds saves and shares.

TUE.goal: Make the 30% donation the hero. Tie shopping directly to impact.

WED.goal: Levity mid-week so the month doesn't get heavy. Pink-themed humor.

THU.goal: Evening reel/quote honoring women — survivors, fighters, tradeswomen.

FRI.goal: Tee up the weekend shop. Feature one product with the donation angle.

SAT.goal: Money slot. High-intent weekend browsing. Best product + lifestyle image.

SUN.goal: Soft, warm close. 'Here's what your orders are funding.' Wind-down shopping.

october_content_angles: 1 in 8 women will face breast cancer — here's how your order helps (VERIFY stat)
Early detection saves lives — a genuine awareness reminder, no product push
Meet the cause: where the 30% actually goes
Pink hard hats, pink ribbons, same fight
Tradeswomen who are survivors — celebrate strength (no face reveals; keep anonymous/illustrative)
Why a tiny POD brand donates 30% — the math of doing good while staying lean
Gift a tradeswoman, fund the research — two good things in one order
The whole month, every order, 30% — no gimmicks

october_tone_shift.keep: The brand's humor and scrappiness — don't go somber. Survivors and fighters appreciate strength and levity.
october_tone_shift.lean_harder_on: The donation. In October, the 30% line can move from a single sentence to the emotional center of more posts.
october_tone_shift.avoid: Trauma-dumping, pinkwashing clichés, exploiting illness for sales. Keep it honest, warm, action-focused. Never imply a specific person's diagnosis.

october_cta_emphasis.primary: Link in bio — every October order sends 30% to breast cancer research.
october_cta_emphasis.dm_keyword: DM PINK for the link — and I'll personally say thank you.
october_cta_emphasis.engagement: Tag a survivor, a fighter, or a tradeswoman who inspires you 🩷

visual_direction_october.palette_override: Shift product/community palettes toward the pink-forward 'awareness' palette in visual-config.json for the full month.
visual_direction_october.motif: Pink ribbon integrated subtly with trade iconography (wrench+ribbon, hard hat+ribbon).
visual_direction_october.note: Dave builds hero graphics in Canva; the auto-renderer uses the october palette for generated cards.

_meta.note: Generator and Scheduler need a small conditional: if current month == October, load this file's daily_schedule_env and weekly_rhythm instead of post-formats.json base_week. Flagged in CONFIG_README.md as the one real code addition.
